quest.title: Watatsumi Sightseeing
quest.description: The war is over, and you have received a letter from Kokomi, saying that Watatsumi Island is going to hold a Victory Feast, and that she would like you to attend. However, when you arrive on Watatsumi Island, you find that not all is right with the world here...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Mora x27825, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

chapter.title: Warriors' Dreams Like Spring Grass Renewing

talks.objective: Go to the agreed location on Watatsumi Island

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: We were lucky to have you here. We'd have had no way to prevent their escape without you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's that you're holding? Is it the directives from Kokomi?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon see... Oh wow, this is a whole book! Is it ALL Kokomi's directives?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Yeah. Well, no, not all of them — I have five more volumes with me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you serious!?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Her Excellency always plans for every scenario. Plus, these are her General Operational Directives, which are more comprehensive than most.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Still, we're fortunate to have them. They make sure we're prepared for every eventuality, no matter how complex.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, understanding every eventuality sounds tiring enough, let alone writing them all down. Must have taken Kokomi a heck of a long time...

dialogues.speaker: Koutoku
dialogues.text: Captain! Are you back on Watatsumi Island to lead Swordfish II again? We've all been feeling your absence.

choices.text: Is Swordfish II still going strong?

response.speaker: Koutoku
response.text: Her Excellency says that now is a time of peace, and that we should reduce the size of the military and focus on helping the civilian population return to normal life.

response.speaker: Koutoku
response.text: About half of us are still organized into task forces, supporting the platoons. The other half have been given various other functions like patrol, construction, and farming.

response.speaker: Koutoku
response.text: Of course, not everyone's happy about it. The other day, an old buddy of mine was grumbling about being forced to build houses. Said they'd have to drag him away from the front line kicking and screaming, hahaha.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The spirit of the resistance is alive and well, huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, we're here because Kokomi invited us to the Victory Feast. Do you know where we can find her, Gorou?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: I believe Her Excellency is currently at Bourou Village.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: There were reports of a possible disturbance over there. If I'm not mistaken, Her Excellency has gone to deal with it in person.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: #We should probably get going ourselves. And uh... {NICKNAME}, on your way over, please check in on the soldiers.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: I'm sensing a growing unease among them, but I don't know what's causing it... They won't say.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: They used to tell me all their concerns, but whatever this is, they're keeping it hidden... I don't like it one bit — I suspect there's trouble afoot.

choices.text: Sure, I'll see what I can do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds good! Paimon was just thinking it'd be good to see everyone again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ready when you are, {NICKNAME}!

choices.text: It'll be nice to catch up with them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be where Kokomi said to meet her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you still remember this place?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon remembers we came by here last time we visited Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was back when you did your stint as Captain of Swordfish II. Paimon's curious whether the resistance troops still remember you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Things on the island must have changed a lot since then! Shall we take a look around?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, isn't that Gorou? Let's go see what he's up to!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: If the enemy outnumbers you, seek their weakness and exploit it. If you outnumber the enemy, seek unequivocal domination and crush them...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Marauders on the waterfront are supplied by sea. Burning their ships is the path to success...

dialogues.speaker: Toshihiko
dialogues.text: General Gorou, Sir. Do you have a verdict?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: More or less. From the directives left behind by Her Excellency, we can surmise that a Fatui ship is moored nearby. This explains their aggressive posture.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: We could split into two teams — one to draw their attention, the other to circle around behind enemy lines and set fire to their ship. They'd have nowhere to run!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Then again, Her Excellency made clear that we are not to split up without sufficient forces. We'd risk being picked off one by one until our whole line of defense disintegrated...

dialogues.speaker: Koutoku
dialogues.text: Sir, shall I send for reinforcements?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I doubt there's time. Based on their movements, they'd likely be gone before our troops arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Her Excellency's directives also stipulate that we should "Wait in ambush and avoid making the first move." Since we lack sufficient troops, I don't think we can afford to engage the enemy at this time.

dialogues.speaker: Toshihiko
dialogues.text: Sir... We're just going to stand by and watch them leave? Surely there must be another way!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: ...Her Excellency's directives also state: "Help may arrive when all seems lost..." As for where this help is supposed to come from, I—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Gorou! What're you guys up to?

dialogues.speaker: Koutoku
dialogues.text: Captain! You've returned to Watatsumi Island!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here to lend a hand.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: #That's great! Her Excellency's directives are as reliable as ever... {NICKNAME}, you've arrived just in time.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Recently, the remnants of the Fatui forces have been unusually active. We've been monitoring their movements waiting in ambush here.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, we don't have the manpower to split into two teams. Can we ask you to keep them occupied?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hard to say no when it's the Fatui. Whatever they're planning, we won't let them get away with it.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Good! There's not a moment to lose. We'll go behind enemy lines and sabotage their ship. Let's meet back here afterward.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Watch yourselves. We'll be back shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like the resistance still remembers us! C'mon, let's help them get this situation under control!

dialogues.speaker: Denjirou
dialogues.text: Wait, aren't you... Captain of Swordfish II?

dialogues.speaker: Denjirou
dialogues.text: It is you! You have our gratitude, Watatsumi Island wouldn't have come to peace without your efforts.

dialogues.speaker: Denjirou
dialogues.text: I wasn't with Swordfish II, but I did see you in Tatarasuna.

dialogues.speaker: Denjirou
dialogues.text: You really gave it to those Shogunate Samurai in the fight of honor! It was quite the show!

dialogues.speaker: Denjirou
dialogues.text: Is there anything you need from me? I'm at your service!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've heard people are a bit on edge these days...

dialogues.speaker: Denjirou
dialogues.text: On edge, you say? Ah yeah... Yeah, I've noticed it too.

dialogues.speaker: Denjirou
dialogues.text: In fairness, the battle isn't long over and, well, perhaps it isn't quite over for them, know what I mean? Every single person looked death in the face that day. That's not an experience you forget in a hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Denjirou
dialogues.text: Victory's declared and all of a sudden, the fighting's over — but people can't just snap back into normal life again. I think things will improve, but it's gonna take some time.

dialogues.speaker: Denjirou
dialogues.text: I don't know what else it could be. But what I do know is that as long as Her Excellency is with us, Watatsumi Island is safe.

dialogues.speaker: Denjirou
dialogues.text: And all the more so now that you're back! Seriously, if there's ever anything you need, just say the word.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a nice guy... Let's go ask some other people.

dialogues.speaker: Arisawa
dialogues.text: *yawn*... Peace at last... Livin' the dream...

dialogues.speaker: Arisawa
dialogues.text: Hmm? Don't I know you...?

dialogues.speaker: Arisawa
dialogues.text: I've definitely seen you somewhere before... Can't place you, but I'm guessing you're not with the Shogun's Army. So, do you need something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hear people are feeling unsettled at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Arisawa
dialogues.text: Unsettled? ...Unsettled how? I haven't noticed anything.

dialogues.speaker: Arisawa
dialogues.text: Not that I would, necessarily. I keep to myself mostly. They're all too rowdy for me.

dialogues.speaker: Arisawa
dialogues.text: We're at peace now, finally, and I for one intend to make the most of it. My life right now is about two things, and two things only: the sun and the sea breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Arisawa
dialogues.text: *yawn* Sorry that I can't be of more help to you. I'll tell you someone you could ask, though — Sangonomiya. She knows everything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... Seems he's about to fall asleep. Let's leave him to rest and go find someone else to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshihisa
dialogues.text: Ugh, I don't understand what Her Excellency is thinking. I mean, peace talks? Gimme a break. Why would she agree to that?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuneo
dialogues.text: Exactly... everyone knows you can't trust the Tenryou Commission. I heard they've been secretly coordinating with the Fatui and plan to continue their attacks.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshihisa
dialogues.text: Wait, for real? You're sure of this?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuneo
dialogues.text: Positive. Some of our guys had a run-in with a few Fatui. They caught them conspiring together, first-hand.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshihisa
dialogues.text: I knew it! The Tenryou Commission are a bunch of crooks — they'll never change. Honestly... it's kinda naive of Her Excellency to take them at their word, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuneo
dialogues.text: Shh, keep your voice down, someone's coming.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, whatcha talkin' about?

dialogues.speaker: Yoshihisa
dialogues.text: #Oh, uh, Captain {NICKNAME}? You're back!

choices.text: I'm here to join you at the Victory Feast.

response.speaker: Yoshihisa
response.text: Do you think we should tell the captain about what we were discussing just now?

response.speaker: Tsuneo
response.text: #No, let's not mention it. {F#She}{M#He}'s one of her closest advisers. For all we know, the peace talks could have been {F#her}{M#his} idea...

response.speaker: Yoshihisa
response.text: I'm sure the captain would see where we're coming from... But you're right, we should probably play it safe.

response.speaker: Yoshihisa
response.text: Uh, welcome back to Watatsumi Island, Captain! Nothing to report here, everything is A-OK!

response.speaker: Tsuneo
response.text: Her Excellency should be in the village at present. Head straight over if you wish, Captain!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, Paimon definitely detected some hush-hush going on there... But if they aren't gonna talk, we might as well head over to the village.

talks.objective: Investigate the quarrel between the soldiers and the merchants

dialogues.speaker: Matsuda
dialogues.text: Admit it! We know you've been secretly supplying the Tenryou Commission with goods purchased on Watatsumi Island!

dialogues.speaker: Matsuda
dialogues.text: I knew something was off about a Tenryou Commission merchant doing business here. So what do you have to say for yourself, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Naruse
dialogues.text: I'm innocent...

dialogues.speaker: Uchimura
dialogues.text: Ha! You're as guilty as they come. You never should've been allowed to set foot on this island, let alone do business here.

dialogues.speaker: Uchimura
dialogues.text: Take him away!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hold on, are we...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Wait!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kokomi! There you are!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Something's going down over here, you should take a look, pronto!

dialogues.speaker: Matsuda
dialogues.text: Your Excellency! This merchant is suspected of criminal activity, so we seized him for questioning.

dialogues.speaker: Matsuda
dialogues.text: Our surveillance shows that in his whole time here, he has made numerous purchases but no sales. And yet he has no stock in his possession. We believe it's highly probable that he has been supplying the Tenryou Commission behind the scenes!

dialogues.speaker: Naruse
dialogues.text: I—I haven't... I...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: That will do. Let's not let ourselves get too worked up here, shall we? Everyone take a deep breath with me, in... and out... Better?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Matsuda, Uchimura — I understand that you're concerned for the safety of Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: But before we make any decision over whether this merchant is guilty or not, we must give him the chance to explain himself.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: If he's guilty, of course there will be consequences. But if he's innocent, he doesn't deserve to be falsely accused. This is Watatsumi Island. We deal in facts, not opinions.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Excuse me, Sir. As you know, my subordinates have some concerns surrounding your commercial activity here. Perhaps you could explain your side of the story, to help me reach a verdict?

dialogues.speaker: Naruse
dialogues.text: Of course, I can explain everything!

dialogues.speaker: Naruse
dialogues.text: I'm a trader on the island, so naturally I've built up some inventory. I was planning to hold off on selling until the prices went up, but then... Uh, ahem.

dialogues.speaker: Naruse
dialogues.text: Uh... Oh, oh! But then, I was robbed by the Fatui. They took everything! Think about that! First I lose all my inventory, then I get treated like a criminal...

dialogues.speaker: Uchimura
dialogues.text: Hmph. And why should we believe you?

response.speaker: Uchimura
response.text: So what? That doesn't prove they took his goods!

response.speaker: Uchimura
response.text: And even if they did, it'll still end up in the Tenryou Commission's hands. They're in this together!

response.speaker: Naruse
response.text: What? The Tenryou Commission are colluding with the Fatui now? ...That's the first I've heard of it!

response.speaker: Naruse
response.text: Suppose it is true — what's that got to do with me...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Would the Tenryou Commission start colluding with the Fatui after the fighting's already finished? Hmm, seems unlikely to Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We met a representative of the Kujou Clan recently. It doesn't seem like he'd have the time to be colluding right now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But on the way over here, we accidentally-on-purpose overheard some soldiers mention the exact same thing. Kokomi, do you know anything about it?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: It has been brought to my attention, yes.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: We are scheduled to begin peace talks with the Tenryou Commission soon. The Kamisato Clan has arranged for them to take place in a neutral location.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Kujou Sara and I will be accompanied by our guards. We will use the talks to discuss future plans in detail.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: But just as arrangements for the peace talks began to fall into place, I started hearing rumors of collusion between the Kujou Clan and the Fatui. Allegedly, their goal is to completely wipe out Watatsumi Island.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: If that is the case, then the peace talks are likely a trap. Even the Kamisato Clan could be involved...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Sir, are you quite certain that your goods were stolen by the Fatui?

response.speaker: Naruse
response.text: Yes, it's the truth, I swear! They stole my goods and then ran off that way. I'll bet that's where their hideout is!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Very well. Hmm... The potential ramifications of this incident are serious. We will retrieve your goods and if everything is in order, it will prove your innocence.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: However, if we find evidence to corroborate the claims of collusion between the Fatui and the Tenryou Commission, I expect you to fully comply with our investigation. Do we have an understanding?

response.speaker: Naruse
response.text: Yes, of course! Thank you, Your Excellency.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Matsuda, Uchimura?

response.speaker: Matsuda
response.text: Well received, Your Excellency.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Good. Now, Traveler— I mean, Captain of Swordfish Platoon, Section II, would you join me in the investigation?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Hehe, good... I look forward to seeing how you've progressed lately.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Ah... I also have a few new things to teach you. Alright, follow me.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Hehe, at ease, soldier! For the time being, at least, we are in peace time.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Besides, I'm sure you won't be on Watatsumi Island forever. Whatever titles we may have, we're friends first and foremost.

dialogues.speaker: Denjirou
dialogues.text: I'm right here if you need any help.

dialogues.speaker: Arisawa
dialogues.text: *yawn*... I'd love to help you more, but uh, kinda resting here, so...

dialogues.speaker: Yoshihisa
dialogues.text: Uh — reporting in Captain! ...Nothing to report!

dialogues.speaker: Tsuneo
dialogues.text: If you're looking for Her Excellency, you should find her in the village.

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher
dialogues.text: Comrades! They've set the ship on fire!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher
dialogues.text: An arson attack!? Curse them!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher
dialogues.text: They leave us no choice but to attack! Comrades, let's make them regret it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we do find the merchant's goods in the hands of the Fatui, it'll prove he's innocent.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whatever's going on between the Fatui and the Tenryou Commission, we need to get to the bottom of it!
